description:
See what your home would actually net if you sold now. Take the free Pre-Sale Profit Map: https://realestatesteph.co/pre-sale-profit-map/
Every agent tells you now is a great time to sell. That's not an answer. For home sellers in Central Texas trying to decide whether to sell now or wait, the 2026 market data tells a clearer story, and it comes down to one number: there are nearly six times more homes for sale today than there were in early 2022.
This video walks through the actual local data for Killeen, Fort Hood, Georgetown, Round Rock, and Pflugerville: what the inventory shift means for your leverage, the three factors that should actually drive your decision, and the carrying-cost math most sellers never run. If you've owned your home five or more years and you're sitting on this decision, this is the framework to use.
The honest version: waiting isn't wrong, but it has to pencil. This shows you how to know whether it does for your specific situation.
⏱️ CHAPTERS
0:00 — Why "now is always a great time to sell" isn't an answer
0:35 — The confusion every seller is dealing with
1:20 — The one number that explains this market
3:45 — What the shift means for your money
6:20 — Why days on market matters more than you think
8:25 — The three factors that should drive your decision
11:00 — What waiting actually costs you per month
11:50 — "But what if rates come down?" — the honest answer
13:10 — Your next step
